newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes unchanged on low dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes unchanged on low dlr demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed unchanged against the dollar on Monday, due to low commercial demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.47 to the dollar.
A Standard Chartered Bank dealer said there was a little demand for dollars but not enough to make an impact.
"There will have to be an import bill of over 10-12 million dollars, to make a difference," he added.
Overnight call money rates closed at 9.625 percent, after rising to 10 percent due to borrowing by a big state bank, dealers said.
